title: n8n Pricing 2026: Plans, Free Tier & Costs Explained
summary: n8n pricing structures vary significantly between managed cloud hosting and local deployments. Compare monthly expenses to select the best infrastructure.
body_markdown:
## n8n Pricing Plans and Feature Limits


n8n Cloud Tiers 2026 Monthly Price (Annual) Included Executions Active Workflows


Starter $20 2,500 5


Pro $50 10,000 50


Business $800 40,000 Unlimited


n8n Cloud pricing is execution-based: you pay for successful workflow runs, not steps or users. Annual-billing plans are Starter at $20 per month for 2,500 executions, Pro at $50 for 10,000, and Business at 667€ for 40,000. The self-hosted Community edition is free, but Enterprise self-hosting requires a paid license.


*Prices and plan limits checked against[n8n.io](https://n8n.io/pricing) on October 17, 2026.*


By defining the operational ceiling for your automation stack, these tiers determine how frequently your systems can sync data before you reach your quota.


### n8n starter plan workflow and feature limits


When you have simple synchronization tasks, the Starter plan acts as a low-cost entry point. Because active workflows are unlimited, you can cover comprehensive business coverage without prioritizing a few automations.


According to neomanex, n8n offers **400 native integrations** , providing a broad ecosystem for users to connect their existing software stack without custom development. This is significantly fewer than the 9,000 offered by Zapier.


Because of this gap, you are required to frequently build custom HTTP requests for niche SaaS tools, which means you'll face a steeper learning curve to achieve basic automation parity.


This $20 price point undercuts enterprise-grade middleware like Workato, which maintains 1,200 integrations but at a much higher cost of entry, effectively positioning n8n as the budget-friendly alternative for scaling businesses.


### n8n pro plan execution limits and pricing


By increasing your execution limit to **10,000 per month** , the Pro plan allows for polling intervals as frequent as every five minutes for a single critical process.


With unlimited active workflows, you can move beyond business-critical CRUD operations into multi-step logic involving advanced models like Claude Sonnet 5.5 for data transformation.


The run is the meter, not the steps inside it. Activepieces offers unlimited flows on every plan, including free, and meters only the underlying AI usage via credits rather than the workflow steps themselves.


This allows teams to build reliable, multi-step processes without the per-task costs found on Zapier or Make, ensuring the meter only runs when the work starts.


### n8n power plan executions and pricing


Production-grade reliability is the focus of the Business plan, which offers **40,000 executions** for high-frequency webhooks and large-scale data migrations.


At this scale, n8n competes with Tray.io, which offers 700 integrations, by providing a more flexible environment for developers who prefer code-heavy nodes over rigid UI connectors.


Even complex setups can map out your entire lead-to-cash lifecycle without hitting architectural bottlenecks thanks to unlimited active workflows.
